name: XCC_BC_BUSINESS_FUNCTIONS
description: This tables stores the business functions that support budgetary control

columns.name: BUSINESS_FLOW_CODE
columns.description: Represents the Business Flow such as Ledger, Procure To Pay, Project Portfolio Management.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_IN_FLOW
columns.description: Indicates the sequence number of the business function within its flow. For example in PTP Flow, Requisitioning would be 1, Procurement would be 2.

columns.name: SET_PARTIAL_RESERVATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator whether or not the user can set the Partial Reservation Flag during enablement. It is a Yes/No flag.

columns.name: ALLOW_PARTIAL_FLAG
columns.description: Partial Reservation Allowed indicator. It can be Y for Yes, N for No or O for Optional.

columns.name: SET_RESERVE_ON_SUBMIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator whether or not the user can set the Reserve On Submit Flag during enablement. It is a Yes/No flag.

columns.name: SET_EA_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator whether or not the user can set the Encumbrance Accounting Enablement Flag during enablement. It is a Yes/No flag.

columns.name: ALLOW_RESERVE_FLAG
columns.description: Allows reserve funds on submit indicator. Valid values are Y for Yes or N for No.

columns.name: LOWEST_AUTHORITY_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the business function uses single overrider mode with lowest authorized amount overrider. Default value is No in most cases.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
